content:
Hey everyone,

I am a 3rd year undergraduate at McMaster University in Canada. Right now, I am trying to formalize the basics of Stanley-Reisner and combinatorial commutative algebra. It's for a summer research project I'm doing over the next two months, I will be following Herzog and Hibi's book on monomial ideals mostly but I will also look at Stanley's book.

I am aware of contributions made by Archibald Browne and Nick Adfor, and some stuff about abstract simplicial complexes, but if any of you know about other contributions please let me know.

Thank you!

Matthew
Hey, could you link the contributions you're referring to? I couldn't find them
Archie has a private repository, Nick I just talked to about his research group which was cancelled I believe. I'm not sure of anyone else.
